description: Retrieve current Stripe state for one OpenTrain payout invoice and report whether the transfer is live, reversed, missing, mismatched, or unavailable, including whether OpenTrain disagrees with Stripe. Read-only; never creates, retries, reverses, or reconciles a payment. Requires payments:read.

invoiceId.description: OpenTrain payout invoice id to verify.

name: opentrain_verify_payout
